titleStmt.title: Memorandum From Roger Fontaine of the National Security Council Staff to the President’s Assistant for National Security Affairs (Allen)

div.head: 461. Memorandum From Roger Fontaine of the National Security Council Staff to the President’s Assistant for National Security Affairs (Allen)

list.label: SUBJECT
list.item: IG Meeting on Venezuela, March 27, 1981 (Chaired by John Bushnell) (U)

div.p: The cancelled Herrera visit robbed the IG of its reason for being, but we met anyway. It became a general seminar of US-Venezuelan relations with two issues discussed. (C)

First, possible F–16 or FX sales to Venezuela. State representatives expressed skepticism of Venezuela’s need for the F–16 while DOD representatives argued that Venezuela’s full and equal partnership with the US in the Caribbean gave it the right to request what it wanted with the expectation of getting them. Final decision awaits our arms sales policy. (C)

Second issue involved the final settlement of oil companies’ expropriation by the Venezuelan government. Half the compensation remains in an escrow account subject to Venezuelan legal claims which are currently going through the Venezuelan courts. Until now, the US has had no policy and the matter has dragged on for five years. Therefore, a subgroup of the IG will write a paper over the next three weeks sketching out the options. (S)

Finally, Deputy Secretary Eaton told the IG that no mention of the aborted Venezuelan visit should be made. Leaking of it would cause some embarrassment, etc. Since 25 people were present, leaking seems inevitable. (S)

note.p: Source: Reagan Library, Robert H. Lilac Files, Arms Transfer: Country File, 1981–1983, AT: Venezuela [February 1981–March 1981]. Secret. Sent for information. A copy was sent to John Treat of the National Security Council staff. An unknown hand wrote and underlined “JC & BN have seen” at the bottom of the page.

In a March 30 memorandum to Venezuela IG members, Bushnell reported the March 27 interagency meeting on Venezuela. (Reagan Library, Roger W. Fontaine Files, Subject File, Venezuela [February 1981–March 1981])
